name: Plum Afterglow
direction: Cozy evening minimalism: ink and plum surfaces, cream text, dusty rose interaction, pale gold highlights. One 42px bottom panel; wide album-art music popup and useful tools on demand.

geometry.composition: One 42px bottom panel: menu and workspaces left, running apps center, clock and essential status right. Desktop empty at rest. Wide album-art music popup and separate useful tools on demand.

preservation: Custom music commands and playback behavior

wallpaper.description: Ink to plum field with restrained rose glow; supplied Apple/LM silhouette centered in muted lavender, rose, peach and pale gold. Original geometry and lettering preserved. No physical material simulation.

brand_color_source: Supplied Apple/LM silhouette with muted lavender, pale gold, peach, rose, mauve and blue bands
